title: Email: Supplier price increase
passage:
From: Martin Hale, Sales Manager, Coastal Paper Co.
To: Purchasing Department, Brightside Printing
Subject: Price changes

Dear Customer,

I am writing to inform you that, due to rising costs of raw materials and transportation, the prices of our paper products will increase by 6 percent starting October 1. The increase applies to all standard paper products, including copy paper, envelopes, and cardstock. Wood pulp prices have reached their highest level in a decade, and shipping rates from our carriers have also risen sharply this year.

We have tried hard to avoid this increase and have kept our prices unchanged for the past three years. We greatly value our partnership with Brightside Printing, and we are grateful for your loyalty during these difficult times.

To help you prepare, any orders placed before September 30 will be charged at the current prices, even if they are delivered after October 1. In addition, customers who sign a one-year supply agreement by the end of September will have their prices fixed at the current level until next September. The agreement covers a monthly minimum order of 500 reams and can be renewed at the end of the term. Your account manager will be happy to explain the details. Our sales team has also prepared a comparison of the two options, which will be sent to your office next week.

Please contact me if you would like to discuss these options. If you need more time to review the new prices, please let us know by September 15 so that we can adjust your order schedule.

Sincerely,
Martin Hale
translation:
お客様各位

原材料費と輸送費の上昇により、10月1日から当社の紙製品の価格を6%引き上げることをお知らせします。今回の値上げは、コピー用紙、封筒、厚紙を含むすべての標準的な紙製品に適用されます。パルプの価格は10年来の最高水準に達しており、今年は運送会社の運賃も大幅に上がっています。

この値上げを避けるよう努力し、過去3年間は価格を据え置いてまいりました。ブライトサイド印刷様とのお取引を大変大切に思っており、厳しい時期にもご愛顧いただいていることに感謝しております。

ご準備いただけるよう、9月30日までのご注文は、10月1日以降の納品でも現在の価格で請求いたします。さらに、9月末までに1年間の供給契約を結ばれたお客様は、来年9月まで現在の価格に固定されます。この契約は毎月500連を最低注文量とし、契約期間の終了時に更新できます。詳細は担当の営業担当者からご説明いたします。担当の営業チームは、2つの選択肢を比べた資料も用意しており、来週中にお客様のオフィスへお送りします。

これらについてご相談があれば、私にご連絡ください。新しい価格を検討するお時間が必要な場合は、9月15日までにお知らせください。ご注文の予定を調整いたします。

コースタル製紙 営業部長 マーティン・ヘイル

title: Notice: Museum night event
passage:
Science After Dark
City Science Museum | Friday, November 15 | 7:00–10:00 P.M.

This special evening event is for adults aged 18 and over. Explore the museum's exhibits without the daytime crowds and enjoy live science demonstrations, a planetarium show, and talks by local scientists. The Hall of Light will be open to the public for the first time, with new interactive displays about lasers and color. Guided tours of the dinosaur gallery will start at 7:15 P.M., and each tour lasts about thirty minutes.

This month's theme is "The Science of Food." Learn why bread rises, how chocolate is made, and what makes spicy food hot. Each demonstration is led by staff from the museum's education department and lasts about twenty minutes. The planetarium show runs every half hour, so visitors can plan their evening around their favorite sessions. Snacks and drinks will be available for purchase in the museum café. The café will also offer a special menu inspired by the theme, featuring foods that are discussed during the talks.

Tickets are $20 ($15 for museum members) and must be purchased online in advance. Tickets will not be sold at the door. Photo ID will be checked at the entrance. Because the event involves a lot of walking, please wear comfortable shoes. Coats and bags can be stored in the lockers near the main lobby.

For more information or to reserve a group visit, please call the visitor services desk at 555-0144 or visit our website. Our staff are happy to help with questions about accessibility and parking as well.
translation:
夜の科学ミュージアム
市立科学博物館/11月15日(金)午後7時〜10時

18歳以上の大人向けの特別な夜のイベントです。昼間の混雑のない館内で展示を楽しみ、科学の実演、プラネタリウム、地元の科学者による講演をお楽しみください。初めて一般公開される「光のホール」では、レーザーや色に関する新しい体験型展示をご覧いただけます。恐竜ギャラリーのガイドツアーは午後7時15分から始まり、1回約30分です。

今月のテーマは「食べ物の科学」。パンがふくらむ理由、チョコレートの作り方、辛い食べ物が辛い理由を学びます。各実演は博物館の教育部のスタッフが担当し、約20分です。プラネタリウムは30分ごとに上映するので、お好みの回に合わせて夜の予定を立てられます。軽食と飲み物は館内のカフェで購入できます。カフェでは、テーマにちなんだ特別メニューも用意します。講演で取り上げられる食べ物を使ったメニューです。

チケットは20ドル(会員は15ドル)で、事前にオンラインで購入する必要があります。当日券の販売はありません。入口で写真付き身分証を確認します。館内は歩く距離が長いので、歩きやすい靴でお越しください。コートや荷物は正面ロビー近くのロッカーに保管できます。

詳しい情報や団体での見学のご予約は、来館者サービスデスク(555-0144)までお電話いただくか、当館のウェブサイトをご覧ください。バリアフリーや駐車場についてのご質問も、スタッフがお答えします。

title: Article: Retail store closes
passage:
LONGTIME BOOKSTORE TO CLOSE ITS DOORS

Page & Quill, a family-owned bookstore that has been a fixture on Main Street for 52 years, will close at the end of this month. Owner Robert Fields, 71, said he has decided to retire, and none of his children wished to take over the business. Mr. Fields took over the store from his parents in 1995, after working there as a teenager.

"It's a difficult decision, but it's the right time," Mr. Fields said. He added that sales had actually been stable in recent years, thanks to loyal customers and popular events such as author readings. Many customers have expressed sadness at the news, and some have shared memories of finding their first favorite novel on the shelves or attending story hours with their children.

The store is holding a closing sale, with all books 40 percent off. Mr. Fields said that any books that remain unsold will be donated to local schools and libraries. Store hours will be extended to 8 P.M. on weekdays so that customers have more time to shop before the doors close. Customers can also pick up a free bookmark with every purchase while supplies last.

Local residents are invited to a farewell party on the final Saturday, where Mr. Fields will sign copies of his favorite books. The farewell party will begin at 2 P.M. in the children's corner, and refreshments will be served. He hopes to spend more time gardening and traveling with his wife in retirement.

The building's owner said that a café is expected to open in the space later this year.
translation:
老舗書店が閉店へ

52年間メインストリートにあり続けた家族経営の書店ペイジ&クイルが、今月末で閉店する。店主のロバート・フィールズさん(71)は、引退を決めたが、子どもたちは誰も店を継ぎたがらなかったと語った。フィールズさんは十代のころに店で働いたのち、1995年に両親から店を引き継いだ。

「難しい決断ですが、今がその時です」とフィールズさん。売上は常連客や作家の朗読会などの人気イベントのおかげで、ここ数年は安定していたという。閉店のニュースに悲しみを示す客は多く、初めて好きになった小説を棚で見つけたことや、子どもと一緒に読み聞かせの会に参加したことなどの思い出を語る人もいる。

店では全品40%引きの閉店セールを行っている。売れ残った本は地元の学校や図書館に寄付するという。閉店前に客が買い物できるよう、平日は営業時間を午後8時まで延長する。在庫がなくなるまで、お買い上げのお客様には無料のしおりもお渡しします。

最終土曜日には地元住民向けの送別会が開かれ、フィールズさんが好きな本にサインをする予定だ。送別会は午後2時から子ども向けコーナーで始まり、軽食も用意されます。引退後は妻と庭いじりや旅行を楽しみたいと話している。

建物の所有者によると、跡地には年内にカフェが開店する見込みだ。

title: Email: Interview follow-up
passage:
From: Human Resources, Vertex Engineering
To: Mr. Samuel Brooks
Subject: Second interview

Dear Mr. Brooks,

Thank you for meeting with us last week regarding the position of Project Engineer. We were impressed with your experience, and we would like to invite you to a second interview. In this role, you would lead small teams on infrastructure projects and work closely with clients from the planning stage to completion.

The second interview will be held on Tuesday, April 23, at 10:00 A.M. and will last approximately two hours. You will meet with the head of the engineering department and two senior engineers. The meeting will take place in Conference Room B on the fourth floor, so please arrive fifteen minutes early to check in at reception. You will also be asked to complete a short technical exercise, which involves reviewing a project report and summarizing your findings. Please bring a laptop, as all the necessary files will be sent to you in advance. The exercise should take about thirty minutes, and you may use any reference materials that you find helpful. Parking vouchers are available at reception.

Please confirm by April 18 whether this date is convenient for you. If you are unable to attend on that day, we can offer April 25 as an alternative. Once you have confirmed, the scheduling team will send you a calendar invitation with the full agenda.

We look forward to speaking with you again. If you have any questions about the schedule or the exercise, please do not hesitate to contact our office at 555-0187.

Sincerely,
Human Resources Department
translation:
ブルックス様

先週はプロジェクトエンジニア職の面接にお越しいただきありがとうございました。ご経験に感銘を受け、二次面接にお招きしたいと思います。この職務では、インフラ事業の小規模チームを率いるほか、企画の段階から完成まで顧客と密に連携していただきます。

二次面接は4月23日(火)午前10時から約2時間の予定です。技術部長と2名の上級エンジニアがお会いします。面接は4階の会議室Bで行いますので、受付で到着をお知らせいただけるよう、15分前にお越しください。また、短い技術課題に取り組んでいただきます。プロジェクトの報告書を読んで、結果を要約していただく内容です。必要なファイルはすべて事前にお送りしますので、ノートパソコンをお持ちください。課題は約30分で終わる見込みで、役立つと思う参考資料は使っていただいて構いません。駐車券は受付でお渡しします。

この日程でよろしいか、4月18日までにご連絡ください。ご都合が悪い場合は、4月25日もご用意できます。ご確認いただいた後、日程担当が詳細な議題を記載したカレンダーの招待をお送りします。

改めてお話しできるのを楽しみにしております。日程や課題についてご質問があれば、遠慮なく当室(555-0187)までお問い合わせください。

人事部

title: Notice: Building maintenance
passage:
Notice to All Tenants — Harborview Office Tower

The building's heating system will be inspected and repaired from Saturday, October 5, to Sunday, October 6. Work crews will begin early on Saturday morning and expect to finish the inspection by Sunday evening. The repairs include replacing two old boilers and updating the control system. Signs will be posted in the lobby to show the work schedule for each floor. During this time, there will be no heating or hot water in the building.

Tenants who plan to work in the building over the weekend should be aware that indoor temperatures may become uncomfortable. Tenants who store temperature-sensitive materials should plan accordingly. Tenants who are unsure whether the work will affect their office should contact the building office in advance. Portable heaters are not permitted due to fire safety regulations.

In addition, the main entrance will be closed on Saturday to allow equipment to be brought in. Please use the side entrance on Pearl Street. Security staff will be on duty there throughout the weekend. Tenants are asked to bring their access cards, as the side entrance requires card access on weekends.

All systems are expected to be working normally by Monday morning. We apologize for any inconvenience. Tenants with questions about the schedule or who need to report a problem should call the building office at extension 200 during business hours. Emergency calls can be made to the security desk at any time. Notices about any changes to the schedule will be posted on the building's website and in the lobby.

Building Management
translation:
ハーバービュー・オフィスタワー入居者の皆様へ

10月5日(土)から6日(日)まで、建物の暖房設備の点検と修理を行います。作業員は土曜日の早朝から作業を始め、日曜日の夕方までに点検を終える予定です。修理では古いボイラー2台の交換と制御システムの更新を行います。各階の作業日程を示す掲示を、ロビーに出します。この間、建物内では暖房と給湯が使えません。

週末に建物内で仕事をする予定の方は、室温が下がり不快になる場合があることにご注意ください。温度に敏感な資材を保管している入居者の方は、事前にご対策をお願いします。作業の影響があるかどうかわからない入居者の方は、事前に管理事務所にご連絡ください。防火規則により、携帯用ヒーターの使用は禁止です。

また、機材を搬入するため、土曜日は正面玄関を閉鎖します。パール通り側の通用口をご利用ください。通用口には週末を通して警備員が常駐します。週末は通用口でカードによる入館確認が必要ですので、入館証をお持ちください。

月曜日の朝までにはすべての設備が通常どおり動く見込みです。ご不便をおかけし申し訳ありません。日程についてご質問がある場合や問題を報告したい場合は、営業時間中に内線200の管理事務所までお電話ください。緊急の場合は、いつでも警備デスクにご連絡いただけます。日程に変更がある場合は、建物のウェブサイトとロビーでお知らせします。

ビル管理部

title: Memo: Lunch-and-learn sessions
passage:
MEMO
To: All Employees
From: Learning & Development Team
Subject: New lunch-and-learn sessions

Starting in February, we will hold monthly lunch-and-learn sessions in the main conference room. Each one-hour session will feature a short talk by an employee or guest speaker on a topic related to professional development. The sessions are designed to help staff build practical skills that they can use in their daily work, regardless of department. Each session will also include a short question-and-answer period at the end.

Upcoming sessions:
• February 12 — Time Management Tips (Sarah Kim, Operations): Learn how to plan your week and reduce daily interruptions.
• March 11 — Introduction to Data Visualization (Guest: Dr. Leo Tran)
• April 8 — Presenting with Confidence (James Ortiz, Marketing): Practice simple techniques for calm, clear speaking.

A light lunch will be provided, so please register at least three days in advance so that we can order enough food. Sessions will also be recorded for those who cannot attend. Please arrive a few minutes early so that each session can start on time. Feedback forms will be distributed after each session, and your comments will help us plan future topics. Those who attend at least three sessions will receive a certificate of completion from the Learning & Development Team. Please note that the main conference room will be reserved for these sessions from 12:00 to 1:30 P.M.

If you would like to lead a session in the future, please contact our team. Employees who have suggestions for topics can also send them to the team by email.

title: Email: Volunteer thank-you
passage:
From: Grace Lin, Riverside Animal Shelter
To: Volunteers
Subject: Thank you!

Dear Volunteers,

Thank you to everyone who helped at our adoption fair last Saturday, including those who came from neighboring towns. Many of you arrived before the doors opened and stayed until the last visitor had left, and we truly appreciate your dedication. A special thank-you goes to the volunteers who helped with the adoption paperwork and the health checks. Thanks to your hard work, 28 dogs and 15 cats found new homes — a new record for our shelter!

We also raised $3,200 through donations and the sale of homemade treats. This money will be used to repair the roof of our dog kennels before winter. The roof has been leaking during heavy rain, so the repair crew will begin work in late October.

Our next event will be a dog-walking day on November 9. We need volunteers to help register participants and to walk dogs with visitors. The event will run from 9 A.M. to 1 P.M. in Riverside Park, and light refreshments will be served to all helpers. Walking routes will be planned in advance, and each volunteer will be given a map and a short safety guide. If you are available, please reply to this email by November 1. Please also let us know which tasks you would prefer, and we will do our best to match you with a role that suits your skills. Your help means a great deal to the animals, and we hope to see many of you there.

With gratitude,
Grace Lin
Volunteer Coordinator
translation:
ボランティアの皆さん

近隣の町から来てくださった方々も含め、先週土曜日の譲渡会を手伝ってくださった皆さん、ありがとうございました。開場前から来てくださり、最後のお客様が帰るまで残ってくださった方も多く、皆さんの熱意には心から感謝しています。特に、譲渡の書類作業と健康チェックを手伝ってくださった方々に、心より感謝します。皆さんの努力のおかげで、犬28匹と猫15匹に新しい家族が見つかりました。当シェルターの新記録です!

また、寄付と手作りおやつの販売で3,200ドルが集まりました。このお金は冬が来る前に犬舎の屋根を修理するのに使います。雨の日に屋根から水が漏れており、修理は10月下旬に始まる予定です。

次のイベントは11月9日の犬の散歩デーです。参加者の受付や、来場者と一緒に犬を散歩させる手伝いをしてくれるボランティアが必要です。イベントはリバーサイド公園で午前9時から午後1時まで行われ、お手伝いくださる方には軽い飲み物と軽食をご用意します。散歩のコースは事前に決めておき、各ボランティアには地図と簡単な安全ガイドをお渡しします。参加できる方は11月1日までにこのメールに返信してください。希望する担当もあわせてお知らせいただければ、スキルに合う役割をできるだけご用意します。皆さんのお力添えは動物たちにとって大きな支えです。当日お会いできるのを楽しみにしています。

感謝を込めて
ボランティア・コーディネーター グレース・リン
